rows.label: SOLAR MONTH
rows.clue: One-twelfth of a solar or tropical year

rows.label: INCIPIENCE
rows.clue: Beginning to exist or to be apparent

rows.label: DURATION
rows.clue: The period of time during which something continues

rows.label: WIDOWHOOD
rows.clue: The time of a woman's life when she is a widow

rows.label: TRAVEL TIME
rows.clue: A period of time spent traveling

rows.label: CLOSING TIME
rows.clue: The regular time of day when an establishment closes to the public

rows.label: HALFTIME
rows.clue: An intermission between the first and second half of a game

rows.label: LOCAL TIME
rows.clue: The official time in a local region (adjusted for location around the Earth)

rows.label: EXTRA TIME
rows.clue: Playing time beyond regulation, to break a tie

rows.label: QUADRENNIUM
rows.clue: A period of four years

rows.label: SCHOOLDAYS
rows.clue: The time of life when you are going to school

rows.label: CHUKKA
rows.clue: (polo) one of six divisions into which a polo match is divided

rows.label: DINNERTIME
rows.clue: The customary or habitual hour for the evening meal

rows.label: LONG TIME
rows.clue: A prolonged period of time

rows.label: REAL TIME
rows.clue: The actual time that it takes a process to occur

rows.label: TIME UNIT
rows.clue: A unit for measuring time periods

rows.label: SENILITY
rows.clue: Mental infirmity as a consequence of old age

rows.label: QUESTION TIME
rows.clue: A period during a parliamentary session when members of British Parliament may ask questions of the ministers

rows.label: QUICK TIME
rows.clue: A normal marching pace of 120 steps per minute

rows.label: GOLDEN YEARS
rows.clue: The time of life after retirement from active work

rows.label: GIGAHERTZ
rows.clue: 1,000,000,000 periods per second

rows.label: STARTING TIME
rows.clue: The time at which something is supposed to begin

rows.label: HIGH SEASON
rows.clue: The season when travel is most active and rates are highest

rows.label: PAUSE
rows.clue: A time interval during which there is a temporary cessation of something

rows.label: EXTENSION
rows.clue: A mutually agreed delay in the date set for the completion of a job or payment of a debt

rows.label: BOYHOOD
rows.clue: The childhood of a boy

rows.label: ARRIVAL TIME
rows.clue: The time at which a public conveyance is scheduled to arrive at a given destination

rows.label: TODAY
rows.clue: The present time or age

rows.label: DRY SEASON
rows.clue: One of the two seasons in tropical climates

rows.label: DECADE
rows.clue: A period of 10 years

rows.label: MIDTERM
rows.clue: The middle of the gestation period

rows.label: INTERVAL
rows.clue: A definite length of time marked off by two instants

rows.label: LACTATION
rows.clue: The period following birth during which milk is secreted

rows.label: DEGREE DAY
rows.clue: The day on which university degrees are conferred

rows.label: HONEYMOON
rows.clue: A holiday taken by a newly married couple

rows.label: EQUINOX
rows.clue: Either of two times of the year when the sun crosses the plane of the earth's equator and day and night are of equal length

rows.label: PRESEASON
rows.clue: A period prior to the beginning of the regular season which is devoted to training and preparation

rows.label: HOURS
rows.clue: A period of time assigned for work

rows.label: SOCIAL SEASON
rows.clue: The season for major social events

rows.label: FIRST PERIOD
rows.clue: The first division into which the play of a game is divided

rows.label: RUSH HOUR
rows.clue: The times at the beginning and end of the working day when many people are traveling to or from work

rows.label: SOLAR YEAR
rows.clue: The time for the earth to make one revolution around the sun, measured between two vernal equinoxes

rows.label: LEAD TIME
rows.clue: The time interval between the initiation and the completion of a production process

rows.label: FUTURE
rows.clue: The time yet to come

rows.label: CLOCK TIME
rows.clue: A reading of a point in time as given by a clock

rows.label: LEGAL AGE
rows.clue: The age at which persons are considered competent to manage their own affairs

rows.label: TIMES
rows.clue: A more or less definite period of time now or previously present

rows.label: RADIANT FLUX
rows.clue: The rate of flow of radiant energy (electromagnetic waves)

rows.label: FACE TIME
rows.clue: Work time spent at the location of or in the presence of other people

rows.label: CIVIL DAY
rows.clue: A day reckoned from midnight to midnight

rows.label: EVENING SHIFT
rows.clue: The work shift during the evening (as 4 p.m. to midnight)

rows.label: COLD SPELL
rows.clue: A spell of cold weather

rows.label: GESTATION
rows.clue: The period during which an embryo develops (about 266 days in humans)

rows.label: FLUSH
rows.clue: The period of greatest prosperity or productivity

rows.label: BITS PER SECOND
rows.clue: (computer science) the rate at which data is transferred (as by a modem)

rows.label: MIDSUMMER
rows.clue: June 21, when the sun is at its northernmost point

rows.label: TIME OFF
rows.clue: A time period when you are not required to work

rows.label: WEDDING DAY
rows.clue: The day of a wedding

rows.label: WEDDING NIGHT
rows.clue: The night after the wedding when bride and groom sleep together

rows.label: TENURE
rows.clue: The term during which some position is held

rows.label: SAFE PERIOD
rows.clue: That time during a woman's menstrual cycle during which conception is least likely to occur (usually immediately before of after menstruation)

rows.label: SPLIT SHIFT
rows.clue: A working shift divided into two periods of time with several hours in between

rows.label: INFLATION RATE
rows.clue: The rate of change of prices (as indicated by a price index) calculated on a monthly or annual basis

rows.label: WORK TIME
rows.clue: A time period when you are required to work

rows.label: FIRST QUARTER
rows.clue: The first fourth of the Moon's period of revolution around the Earth

rows.label: WEEKEND
rows.clue: A time period usually extending from Friday night through Sunday

rows.label: MEGACYCLE
rows.clue: One million periods per second

rows.label: LEAP SECOND
rows.clue: A second (as measured by an atomic clock) added to or subtracted from Greenwich Mean Time in order to compensate for slowing in the Earth's rotation

rows.label: RAG WEEK
rows.clue: A week at British universities during which side-shows and processions of floats are organized to raise money for charities

rows.label: PERIOD
rows.clue: An amount of time

rows.label: MAIDEN OVER
rows.clue: (cricket) an over in which no runs are scored

rows.label: TONIGHT
rows.clue: The present or immediately coming night

rows.label: SPACING
rows.clue: The time between occurrences of a repeating event

rows.label: MONTH
rows.clue: One of the twelve divisions of the calendar year

rows.label: GREAT YEAR
rows.clue: Time required for one complete cycle of the precession of the equinoxes, about 25,800 years

rows.label: WEEKDAY
rows.clue: Any day except Sunday (and sometimes except Saturday)

rows.label: MODERN ERA
rows.clue: The present or recent times

rows.label: TIME SLOT
rows.clue: A time assigned on a schedule or agenda

rows.label: LAST HALF
rows.clue: The second of two halves of play

rows.label: BIRTH RATE
rows.clue: The ratio of live births in an area to the population of that area

rows.label: BICENTENNIAL
rows.clue: The 200th anniversary (or the celebration of it)

rows.label: ANACHRONISM
rows.clue: Something located at a time when it could not have existed or occurred

rows.label: RAINY SEASON
rows.clue: One of the two seasons in tropical climates

rows.label: BREAKFAST TIME
rows.clue: The customary or habitual hour for eating breakfast

rows.label: MULTISTAGE
rows.clue: Occurring in more than one stage

rows.label: ELAPSED TIME
rows.clue: The time that elapses while some event is occurring

rows.label: PROBATION
rows.clue: A trial period during which your character and abilities are tested to see whether you are suitable for work or for membership

rows.label: LONGUEUR
rows.clue: A period of dullness or boredom (especially in a work of literature or performing art)

rows.label: OFF YEAR
rows.clue: A year in which productivity is low or inferior

rows.label: TEENS
rows.clue: The time of life between the ages of 12 and 20

rows.label: KILOCYCLE
rows.clue: One thousand periods per second

rows.label: TIME CONSTANT
rows.clue: (electronics) the time required for the current or voltage in a circuit to rise or fall exponentially through approximately 63 per cent of its amplitude

rows.label: LAST MINUTE
rows.clue: The latest possible moment

rows.label: SEASON
rows.clue: A period of the year marked by special events or activities in some field

rows.label: SPRING
rows.clue: The season of growth

rows.label: SOLSTICE
rows.clue: Either of the two times of the year when the sun is at its greatest distance from the celestial equator
